item.question_text: A deployer's resource records list the data sets, the modelling tools and the cloud hosting used by its AI system. An internal audit finds nothing recorded about which specialists, and with what skills, carry out maintenance, transfer and retirement of the system. Which Annex A control category best closes this specific gap?

options.text: The human resources control within resources for AI systems
The AI roles and responsibilities control within internal organization
The tooling resources control within resources for AI systems
The resource documentation control within resources for AI systems

item.explanation: Clause A.4.6 is the resource-identification control aimed at people: it calls for recorded detail on the personnel used for the AI system and the competences they bring, spanning the stages from build and operation through to maintenance, transfer and retirement. The audit finding concerns exactly that missing record of who does the work and with what skills, so A.4.6 is the category that closes it.
item.key_support: As part of resource identification, the organization shall document information about the human resources and their competences utilized for the development, deployment, operation, change management, maintenance, transfer and decommissioning, as well as verification and integration of the AI system.

distractor_support.support: Roles and responsibilities for AI shall be defined and allocated according to the needs of the organization.
distractor_support.why_wrong: This control is about defining and allocating accountability inside the organization, not about documenting the people and competences counted as an AI system resource.

distractor_support.support: As part of resource identification, the organization shall document information about the tooling resources utilized for the AI system.
distractor_support.why_wrong: Tooling is already documented in the scenario, so this control addresses a resource category that is not the gap.

distractor_support.support: The organization shall identify and document relevant resources required for the activities at given AI system life cycle stages and other AI-related activities relevant for the organization.
distractor_support.why_wrong: This is the umbrella identification control, whereas the gap concerns the specific resource category for people and their competences.
